name: gift-card
description: A business card whose QR opens a Lattice gift link: a warm line, the code, and a PIN when the link is locked.
purpose: Printed QR gift cards. `tools/gift-cards.mjs` writes one card per slide at the `card` or `card-iso` size; the QR carries the whole gift link (a spend-capped OpenRouter key in the URL fragment), and the link is never printed as text. Author the fields as a postfix-key list, the link inside a code span.

title.description: The card's line (e.g. "Make your next deck with Lattice.").

fields.description: One field per bullet in postfix-key form — value first, trailing inline-code names the field. Keys: link|url (required; the gift link, written inside a code span: ``- `https://lattice.style/gift#v1.…` `link` ``), pin (printed apart from the code when the link is locked), caption, number|no. The link goes into the QR only and is never shown as text.

eyebrow.description: Optional kicker above the heading, as an inline-code first line: `` `A deck on us` ``.

caption.description: Optional line under the heading, as a postfix-key bullet: ``- Scan to start. `caption` ``.

whenToUse.title: Hand out a trial in person
whenToUse.body: A card a visitor scans in a café opens the Studio with a model key ready and nothing to sign up for. The giver's OpenRouter account pays, capped per card.

whenToUse.title: Lock a card with a PIN
whenToUse.body: Add a `pin` bullet and the card prints it apart from the code, so a photo of the QR alone opens nothing. The CLI's `--pin` writes both.

antiPatterns.title: Not for a slide you show
antiPatterns.body: It is sized for print. On a projected deck, use the contact card with a web link instead.

antiPatterns.title: Never print the link as text
antiPatterns.body: The link is a working key. Keep it in its own bullet, where it becomes only a QR code.

related.name: contact
related.when: the card is a person's identity, not a gift

commonMistakes.mistake: Writing the link without a code span.
commonMistakes.fix: A gift link can hold underscores, which Markdown may read as emphasis and drop, so the QR would carry a broken link. Wrap it in backticks: ``- `https://…` `link` ``.
Without a link there is nothing to encode, and the slide renders as authored, not as a card.

venueCapacity.none: A fixed card, so there is no count budget. `npm run check:venue-conformance` checks its fit at every venue and canvas instead.
